name: tt-win-kmd
description: Experimental Windows 11 KMDF port of the Tenstorrent kernel-mode driver for Blackhole p150a cards. Exposes the same IOCTL ABI as the Linux tt-kmd (byte-identical request structures, checked by static asserts against the upstream header) plus Windows-only map and unmap requests, so tt-umd runs on top through a Windows backend. Enumeration, ARC messaging, TLB windows and DMA buffers are implemented and tested on a p150a and on the ttsim/QEMU rig. The authors mark it unfinished and not production-ready.
author: Enigma-Labs-Technology
